entries.name: PressAndHold
entries.note: a letter held on a hardware keyboard opens its accent list instead of repeating (KeyRepeat::accent_hold, wired in the input loop in src/bin/shell.rs) in the Search field and in a focused app text field, and a digit picks an accent (compose_window.rs); the on-screen keyboard slides out the accents of a held letter (apps/keyboard).
entries.ready_note: holding a letter opens its accent list on hardware and on-screen keyboards, and a digit picks one; the checks run the key-repeat hold rule and the accent window
